create_KittiDataset: create a KittiDataset instance with data_root, ann_file, split, and modality config for 3D object detection
get_data_info_KittiDataset: get data info dict with pts_filename, lidar2img transform, and image info for a given sample index
get_ann_info_KittiDataset: get 3D ground truth bounding boxes, labels, and 2D bboxes annotation info for a given index
evaluate_KittiDataset: evaluate 3D detection results using KITTI protocol metrics including bbox, bev, and 3D AP scores
show_KittiDataset: visualize 3D bounding box detection results by rendering point clouds with ground truth and predicted boxes
